Cons.Name: Static Charge
Cons.Effect: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> 3 times. This effect does not consume any <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> stacks.

Cons.Name: Fail-Safe Protocol
Cons.Effect: Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 6 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> (max 6 stacks). With <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color>, when using <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color> to hit an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> instead. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will still activate the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>.

Cons.Name: Silver Reverb
Cons.Effect: When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.

Cons.Name: Prequel Protagonist
Cons.Effect: Upon triggering 6 instances of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>'s additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
